'''Bossy McBossFace's First mate''' is a skeleton that can spawn during the fight with [[Bossy McBossFace]]. Bossy will on occasion spawn a number of [[summoned skeleton]]s, this group of skeletons may include the first mate.

* {{Achievement|Monkey Sadness}}
